Al Jazeera: Iran will open a communication channel on an MoU after Qatar meetings. Pakistan mediating.

  • תקריות אזוריות: ארבעה רחפנים יורטו בדרכם למוסקבה (לפי ראש העיר). מעיד על שימוש רחב ברחפנים מעבר לציר איראן–ישראל.

  • תמצית טקטית: ההפסקה הקודמת (5 ימים) הופרה על ידי תקיפות על איספהאן/כוררמסהר. החלון הדיפלומטי פגיע.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: דו"חות על שיחות טכניות להבטחת הסדר ולחידוש ההפלגות — חלון לדיפלומטיה נפתח.

הערכת איום: מתמתנת

Situation Report — Day 27 (last 6 hrs)

Strikes / Sirens:
  • Gaza: IDF reports killing a Hamas commander and four operatives. Al Jazeera reports three Palestinians killed despite a declared ‘ceasefire’.
  • Syria: Israeli forces pushing into towns; troops encountered local resistance.
Diplomacy / Talks:
  • US announced a second 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 8 PM ET). Trump says talks “going very well”; Iran denies direct talks.
  • Qatar reports progress in indirect US–Iran talks in Doha. Pakistan mediating channels.
  • Al Jazeera: Iran to open a communication channel on an MoU discussed in Qatar.
  • US official Vance warns US may resume military action if talks fail.
Northern Border:
  • Hezbollah activity continues daily along the Lebanese border. Local Lebanese towns report heavy damage from Israeli operations.
Operations & Air Movements:
  • Multiple military flights tracked across the region over the period (repeated RCH/CNV military traffic logged).
  • Regional airports reported closed earlier (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan) at 17:00 snapshot.
Hormuz & Shipping:
  • Iran allowing passage through Hormuz for select countries (Russia, India, China) while restricting others. Shipping corridors remain politically keyed to talks.
International / Political Moves:
  • US signs symbolic $1 lease to build a permanent embassy in West Jerusalem.
  • Lufthansa and ITA resumed flights to/from Ben Gurion.
🟢 Good News:
  • Technical US–Iran talks reported toward a peace/shipping restart. Airlines resuming some flights. Israeli humanitarian team deployed to Venezuela.
Bottom line threat assessment: escalating

24.en:
ACTIVE: Israeli/US airstrikes inside Iran today. Iranian/Hezbollah/Hamas missile-rocket strikes into Israel. Daily skirmishes on the northern border.

Diplomacy & pauses

  • Trump announced SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes — 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET. He cites an “Iranian Government request.”
  • Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. Doha indirect talks reported as “progressing” by a Qatari diplomat.
  • US and Iran in technical talks to secure a peace deal and restart shipping. First 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • US official Vance warns military action may resume if talks fail.

Military operations

  • US/Israeli airstrikes continue inside Iran. Targets not fully confirmed in open sources.
  • Northern border: Hezbollah launches and fires daily. Exchanges reported every day for the past week.
  • Gaza: IDF reports killing a Hamas commander and four operatives involved in attacks on troops.
  • Regional airspace disruptions continue; several airports remain closed in the conflict zone.

Maritime & strategic

  • Iran allows Hormuz passage for selected friendly states (Russia, China, India). Other nations remain blocked.
  • Pause on energy strikes aims to protect shipping lanes if talks hold. Risk to commercial traffic remains high.

Political & homefront

  • US signs $1 lease with Israel to build a permanent embassy in West Jerusalem.
  • Flights to Ben Gurion partially resuming (Lufthansa, ITA reported).
  • 🟢 Good News: Technical talks underway aimed at restarting shipping. Humanitarian relief team deployed overseas. Some international flights to Ben Gurion resumed.
Threat assessment: Escalating
